# Schema contract mismatch — version 1 — 2026-10-20
Symptoms: missing_column, column amount does not exist, stg_orders.
Confirm: selected dbt invocation and task log name the missing column; compare current raw.orders with orders-v1 baseline. A current observation is not a snapshot of the failed execution.
Action: a developer verifies the producer contract and aligns source mapping or dependent model SQL after review. Preserve source data and record the mapping decision.
Prerequisite: confirm intended meaning of amount and paid_amount; establish which contract is authoritative.
Verification: new execution has all tasks successful and not_null/unique tests passing; inspect daily_orders aggregate.
Exclude: connection refusal, unrelated current schema, and data-quality-only failures. A retry alone does not fix this mismatch.

# dbt connection refused — version 1 — 2026-10-20
Symptoms: connection_refused, connection refused, dbt_orders, dbt_run.
Confirm: failed task log and selected dbt artifacts identify the failing connection. mcp_readonly success only confirms that separate connection.
Action: developer checks dbt endpoint, service availability, routing and authentication using explicitly supplied configuration. Do not expose passwords. Correct a port only if endpoint evidence proves it is wrong.
Prerequisite: establish the actual dbt execution configuration; do not infer an incorrect port from a generic refusal.
Verification: successful new pipeline execution and passing not_null/unique checks; a successful connection probe alone does not prove recovery.
Exclude: schema and data-quality failures with functioning connectivity. Never claim a specific port from an absent log value.

# Null order key — version 1 — 2026-10-20
Symptoms: not_null, order_id, null rows, dbt_test.
Confirm: selected invocation records failing not_null_order_id; current raw.orders profile provides null_counts and limited samples. Do not treat current counts as past counts.
Action: developer verifies source provenance, repairs the source mapping or quarantines invalid records according to the agreed policy, preserving originals.
Prerequisite: confirm business key definition and approved remediation policy.
Verification: separate new execution succeeds, not_null and unique both pass, reconciled counts and aggregates are checked.
Exclude: absent column or failed connectivity; a retry alone cannot repair bad data.

impact: manifest 의존관계상 daily_orders에 영향 가능성이 있으며 실제 모델 실패와는 구분합니다.

prerequisites: 실패 프로세스의 실제 연결 설정을 확인하며 비밀번호는 보고서에 넣지 않습니다.
steps: 실제 dbt 실행 설정의 대상과 서비스 상태를 개발자가 확인하고 확인된 설정 오류를 바로잡습니다.
verification: 사람이 별도 새 실행을 수행하여 모든 태스크 성공과 not_null 및 unique 통과, 집계 정합성을 확인합니다.
